lessons_used: Predictions were consistently too high across all tested changes.
Evidence is still thin for home, wait_info changes (only 1 test).
Evidence is still thin for adoption, redesign changes (only 1 test).
Evidence is still thin for choose_path, reorder changes (only 1 test).
Evidence is still thin for sign_in, notification changes (only 1 test).

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Personality Selector Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the pet selection experience on pick_friend into dynamic cards highlighting pet personalities, desktop habits, and traits.
candidates.why: Adoption step has a 60.9% conversion rate with users spending a long median of 89s evaluating pets without clear personality context.

pick_friend.headline: Meet Your Future Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Explore unique pet personalities and select your ideal companion.

guard.reason: Redesigns pet selection while retaining pet choice functionality within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption redesign historically yielded -9.6% lift and costs a full redesign.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Controls Quick-Start Card
candidates.change: Inserts a new quick-start screen before home_intro that clearly demonstrates desktop shortcuts for summoning, hiding, and chatting with the pet.
candidates.why: Support mail highlights post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the desktop pet.

new_controls_guide.headline: Desktop Pet Quick Controls
new_controls_guide.body: Learn how to easily summon, move, hide, or chat with your pet anywhere on your screen.

guard.reason: Adds an instructional quick-start screen before home_intro without removing required steps.

candidates.score_note: Strong alignment between support complaints and finish step drop, but requires new screen.

candidates.title: Cloud Account Pet Sync Clarification Hint
candidates.change: Adds an explicit explanatory hint on the sign_in screen clarifying that logging in locks your pet data safely to your permanent account.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing back in under different accounts.

sign_in.hint: Sign in to save your pet securely to your cloud account so your progress is never lost across sessions.

guard.reason: Adds a clear explanatory sign-in hint without violating any onboarding constraints.

candidates.score_note: Direct support ticket evidence with low execution cost via hint text.

candidates.title: Real-Time Pet Generation Progress Breakdown
candidates.change: Displays detailed phase-by-phase generation progress and estimated remaining render time on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a high median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, creating uncertainty while pet rendering completes.

waiting.headline: Bringing Your Pet to Life
waiting.body: Configuring 3D model, desktop physics, and AI interactions...

guard.reason: Displays real wait time progress breakdown on the waiting screen, which is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Wait info previously showed +3.8% lift, addressing extreme waiting duration.

candidates.title: Reorder Path Selection Before Account Sign-In
candidates.change: Moves path selection to the very beginning of the onboarding sequence ahead of sign_in so users pick their experience before creating an account.
candidates.why: choose_path drops 23.8% of users early; giving path intent first increases commitment before hitting sign-in friction.

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move

candidates.title: Two-Column Adoption Certificate Preview
candidates.change: Changes adoption_certificate layout to a side-by-side split view showing the certificate form alongside a live animated preview of the adopted pet.
candidates.why: Adoption screen completion drops to 60.9% and takes 89s median.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Give your companion a name to complete the adoption process.

guard.reason: Updates adoption certificate layout to split view while preserving the required functionality.

candidates.score_note: Targets high-drop step, but adoption changes carry high risk of drop-off.

candidates.title: First-Day Companion Playground Guided Tour
candidates.change: Adds a multi-step interactive onboarding flow 'new_interactive_tour' introducing hands-on desktop interaction tasks prior to completing setup.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion is only 64.8% (median 395s) and multiple support emails note confusion over post-onboarding desktop features.

new_interactive_tour.headline: Interactive Desktop Tour
new_interactive_tour.body: Try moving your companion to your favorite spot on the screen!

guard.reason: Inserts a new interactive tour screen into the onboarding flow prior to home_intro.

candidates.score_note: High evidence from support mail and funnel, but expensive interactive flow build.

candidates.title: Background Generation Ready Desktop Notification
candidates.change: Adds a desktop notification opt-in toggle on the waiting screen so users get alerted as soon as pet creation finishes.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes long periods (median 201s, mean 2336s) and 3 support tickets reported pets failing to appear when app is minimized.

waiting.hint: Enable desktop notification so you can safely use other apps while your pet generates.

guard.reason: Tricks or misleads the user into enabling notifications by claiming it is needed to safely use other apps.

candidates.title: Path Choice Duration and Outcome Copy
candidates.change: Clarifies the time commitment and outcome differences between Instant Preset Adoption and Custom AI Generation.
candidates.why: choose_path conversion is 76.2% with a large mean completion time (514s), indicating hesitation.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Adopt?
choose_path.body: Choose Instant Adoption (1 min) or Custom AI Pet Creation (3 mins).

guard.reason: Clarifies adoption path options and estimated times without introducing false urgency.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy change addressing user hesitation at path selection.

candidates.title: Adoption Celebration Digital Badge Incentive
candidates.change: Adds an early adopter digital badge unlock banner to the adoption certificate screen to reward completion.
candidates.why: 39.1% of users drop out during adoption; positive reinforcement encourages certificate completion.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy must not mention rewards, gifts, or free extras such as digital badge incentives.

picked: Cloud Account Pet Sync Clarification Hint
Path Choice Duration and Outcome Copy

decisions.title: Cloud Account Pet Sync Clarification Hint
Path Choice Duration and Outcome Copy

lessons_next: home, wait_info changes are helpful (+3.5% after noise correction across 2 winning tests).
adoption, redesign changes did not work, showing negative or no clear effect (-5.2% after noise correction across 2 tests).
Predictions were inaccurate overall, overestimating early changes but underestimating some round 2 wins.
Evidence is still thin for finish, new_flow changes (only 1 test).
Evidence is still thin for choose_path changes (only 1 test each for reorder and copy).
Evidence is still thin for sign_in changes (only 1 test each for notification and hint).
